description: Destroy the end crystals and defeat the Ender Dragon.
notes: The verifier criterion exists now (`bossDefeated`, fed by the server's boss_event bar cycle and accepting only a show_bar -> hide_bar transition), but the fight itself is not implemented: no end-crystal breaking, no perch phase, no ranged combat. `success` stays null on purpose, so the milestone is never offered and can never be reported as won from a boss that merely stopped being visible.
